# Shardcade logo provenance

Generated with the built-in image-generation tool, then refined with an image edit.
Final asset: `shardcade-logo.png`. The first draft was not shipped.

## Original prompt

Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original project logo for SHARDCADE, a self-hosted retro-game archive and ROM-provider importer. A striking compact geometric emblem combines three crystalline shards into an abstract open arcade doorway, with a tiny subtle cartridge notch in negative space. Brand mood: archival, precise, quietly adventurous; NOT a generic game controller, no franchise symbols. Clean flat vector-like geometry, sharp deliberate cuts, strong silhouette at small sizes. Rich jade/teal emblem with a small warm amber facet, pale ivory uppercase SHARDCADE wordmark in a custom geometric sans, excellent exact spelling. Horizontal lockup centered with generous breathing room, emblem to left of wordmark. Deep charcoal navy solid background, no gradients, no texture, no mockup, no glow, no extra text, no watermark. Wide approximately 3:1 composition suitable for a GitHub README banner. Original symbol, no RomM logo reuse.

## Refinement prompt

Clean up this SHARDCADE logo. Preserve the three teal crystalline arcade-door shards, small amber cartridge shape, horizontal layout and exact word SHARDCADE. Make every edge smooth, solid and sharp. Remove ALL distressed flecks, glitches, ragged edges, holes in letters, debris and stray pixels. Every letter must be uniformly solid pale ivory with only its designed counters; no texture. Use a fully opaque uniform dark charcoal navy background #111923 filling the entire canvas, not transparency. Flat professional vector-like logo, no gradients, no shading noise. Keep wide 3:1 framing with generous margins.
